blocks.text: Benzene sab se ahem organic compounds mein se ek hai; is ka chemical formula C₆H₆ hai. Yeh simplest (sab se saada) aromatic hydrocarbon hai. Benzene se banne wali cheezon ki khushbu achhi hoti hai. Isi liye 19th century (19wi sadi) ke shuru mein scientists ne benzene ring wale organic compounds ko “aromatic” (khushbudar, sweet smelling) kaha. Bohat se aromatic compounds khushbudar hain, jaise vanilla. Ek ya zyada benzene rings wale organic hydrocarbons ko arenes kehte hain. Lekin aaj lafz 'aromatic' un molecules ke liye bhi use hota hai jin mein benzene ya benzene jaisi ring ho, chahe un ki boo achhi na ho balke buri ho.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Yeh kehna ghalat hai ke sirf aromatic compounds hi khushbudar hote hain. Camphor (kaafoor), jo camphor laurel darakht se nikalta hai, non-aromatic hai; is ki khushbu (aroma) tez aur podine (mint) jaisi hai, magar is ke structure mein benzene ring nahi.

Benzene ki discovery (dariyaft) ke baad pata chala ke is ka molecular formula C₆H₆ hai. Phir bohat se scientists ne is ka structure maloom karne ki koshish ki. Kuch ne linear (seedhi zanjeer wale) structures pesh kiye, lekin yeh jald reject (rad) ho gaye kyun ke yeh benzene ki properties (khoobiyan) nahi samjha sakte the.

1865 tak benzene ka structure ek mystery (paheli) raha. Phir German professor August Kekule ne bataya ke yeh six membered cyclic compound (chhe carbon wala ring) hai jis mein single aur double bonds baari baari (alternate) aate hain, jaisa neeche bana hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene ka Kekule structure: chhe C atoms ki ring, har C ke saath aik H, aur carbons ke darmiyan baari baari single aur double bonds; saath hi yahi ring skeletal hexagon ki shakal mein, andar teen double-bond lines ke saath.
blocks.caption: Benzene ka Kekule structure (kitab ke PDF page 60 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is structure ne benzene ki bohat si properties successfully (kamyabi se) samjha deen.
Lekin Kekule ke structure mein kuch problems (masle) the: yeh benzene ki physical aur chemical properties poori tarah nahi samjha sakta tha.

X-ray studies batati hain ke benzene planar (chapta, sab atoms ek hi plane mein) hai: chhe sp² hybridized carbon atoms ka ek regular (barabar) hexagon. Har carbon atom teen aur atoms se jura hai, aur C–C–C aur H–C–C bond angles 120° hain. C–H bond ki length (lambai) 109 pm aur C–C bond ki 139 pm hai. Yeh sp³ carbons ke single bond (154 pm) aur sp² carbons ke double bond (133 pm) ke darmiyan hai. C-C aur C-H bond lengths respectively (isi tarteeb se) 1.3970 Å aur 1.090 Å hain.

blocks.alt: Benzene ring jis ke chhe carbons mein se har aik par H hai. 1.39 angstrom wale label se curly arrow ring ke aik C-C bond ki taraf hai, aur aik carbon par curly arrow ring bond aur C-H bond ke darmiyan 120° ka angle (zaviya) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Benzene mein bond angles aur bond lengths (kitab ke PDF page 60 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kekule ke structure ke mutabiq benzene mein teen chhote double bonds (133 pm) aur teen lambe single bonds (154 pm) hone chahiye the. X-ray batata hai ke chhe ke chhe C–C bonds barabar hain, 139 pm (1.39 Å), yani dono ke darmiyan, aur har angle 120° hai. Isi liye aaj benzene ko hexagon ke andar circle se dikhate hain; circle delocalised π electrons ki nishani hai.

blocks.prompt: X-ray data se kyun pata chala ke Kekule ka structure poori baat nahi batata?
blocks.explanation: Kekule ke structure mein teen chhote double aur teen lambe single bonds hain, lekin X-ray ke mutabiq benzene ke chhe ke chhe C–C bonds ki lambai barabar, 139 pm, hai.

items: Benzene C₆H₆ sab se saada arene hai; 'aromatic' ab benzene jaisi ring ka naam hai, khushbu ka nahi.
Kekule (1865): chhe carbon ka ring, single aur double bonds baari baari.
X-ray: planar barabar hexagon, sab C–C bonds 139 pm, sab angles 120°.
